_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "species" TEXT NULL, "breed" TEXT NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "birthday" INTEGER NULL, "neutered" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("neutered" IN (0, 1)), "allergies" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "chronic_conditions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "avatar_path" TEXT NULL, "is_placeholder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_placeholder" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_activities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "place" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "details_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "route_file_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "numeric_value" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "severity" INTEGER NULL, "details_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pet_photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_path" TEXT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NULL, "original_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "caption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "captured_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_avatar" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_avatar" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "mood_emoji" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_media_refs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "candidate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "care_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_due_at" INTEGER NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paused" IN (0, 1)), "reason_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "rule_id" TEXT NULL, "rule_version" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_plan_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repeat_rule" TEXT NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NULL, "completion_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "completion_target" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'health', "record_type" TEXT NULL, "record_title" TEXT NULL, "record_numeric_value" REAL NULL, "record_unit" TEXT NULL, "record_note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "record_details_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "care_type" TEXT NULL, "care_place" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "care_note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "care_details_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paused" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reminder_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reminders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX care_pet_occurred_at ON care_activities (pet_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX care_pet_type ON care_activities (pet_id, type)
CREATE INDEX memory_entries_pet_occurred ON memory_entries (pet_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX memory_media_entry_position ON memory_media_refs (entry_id, position)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX care_plans_pet_candidate_unique ON care_plans (pet_id, candidate_id)
